original_question: On which chromosome is the gene encoding desmoglein-1 located?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the gene encoding desmoglein-1 located?
final_qi.long_answer: In the human genome the DSG1 gene, which encodes the desmosomal cadherin desmoglein-1, resides in the desmoglein gene cluster on chromosome 18 (band 18q12.1).

final_answer.long_answer: The desmoglein-1 gene (DSG1) maps to the long arm of human chromosome 18 (region 18q12), where it forms part of the desmoglein/cadherin gene cluster.
